newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-JOAO PINTO RECALLED BY PORTUGAL AFTER 18-MONTH ABSENCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JOAO PINTO RECALLED BY PORTUGAL AFTER 18-MONTH ABSENCE.

text.p: Portugal's most capped player Joao Pinto is back in the international fold after an absence of 18 months.
The 34-year-old Porto defender was included on Thursday in a 20-man squad for the World Cup European group nine qualifier against Ukraine in Oporto on November 9.
Joao Pinto, capped 69 times, has made only a handful of appearances for his club in the past two seasons.
He last played for Portugal in a European championship qualifier against Ireland in April 1995.

Defenders - Jorge Costa (Porto), Joao Pinto (Porto), Sergio Conceicao (Porto), Fernando Mendes (Porto), Dimas Teixeira (Benfica), Fernando Nelson (Aston Villa), Fernando Couto (Barcelona), Jose Taira (Salamanca), Oceano Cruz (Sporting).
Midfielders - Antonio Folha (Porto), Helder Cristovao (Benfica), Paulo Alves (Sporting), Luis Figo (Barcelona), Paulo Bento (Real Oviedo), Hugo Porfirio (West Ham)
Forwards - Joao Vieira Pinto (Benfica), Ricardo Sa Pinto (Sporting), Rui Costa (Fiorintina)
